messages.content: "你能幫我找到一個位於加州舊金山的兩房公寓，且價格在我預算範圍內的嗎？我的預算範圍是50萬到80萬美元。之後，你能提供一個位於加州洛杉磯的五年新的三房別墅的估價嗎？最後，我也想知道一個位於紐約市的十年新的一房公寓套房的估價。"

1) find properties (search) at SF with 2-bedroom apartments within $500k-$800k.

We need to call realestate_find_properties with location "San Francisco, CA", propertyType maybe "apartment"? The spec says "two bedroom apartment". So we can set propertyType="Apartment".

But they want two-bed apartment; but also specify price range. We should pass budget {min: 500000, max: 800000}. Also bedrooms=2.

So first tool invocation: realestate_find_properties(location:"San Francisco, CA", propertyType:"Apartment", bedrooms:2, budget:{min:500000,max:800000})

Then second request: estimate value of new 5-year-old 3-bedroom villa in Los Angeles. Use property_valuation_get with location "Los Angeles, CA", propertyType "Villa", bedrooms 3, age 5.

Third request: estimate value of 10-year old one-bedroom suite in New York city. But propertyType? They say "one-room apartment suite." Could use propertyType "Suite" or "Apartment". Let's choose "Suite". Bedrooms 1, age 10, location "New York City, NY"

Thus we will make calls accordingly.

We'll do them sequentially. We'll produce output after each call. Probably best to chain calls: first search results then valuations.

Let's proceed.
